author: Legendary_Dan20
body:
Absolutely not. Castle upgrade will only give you the demonforge right now. In 3.0 it will also give you a coliseum so unless you want that, it's not a great investment.

You're better off purchasing the rest of the classes and planning out which pets you're going to purchase in t9 and t10.

Also remember that altar will cost 50 million orns. IMO castle is not worth the upgrade.
